messages:
ci-bot: automated secret scanner flagged a high-confidence match: 
ci-bot: file `ci/pipeline.yml` in build-1342 contained what looks like an AWS access key in a step log. md5 snippet: `AKIA...` (redacted)
ci-bot: link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/1342/logs#step-7
maria-sec: got it. thanks for the alert. immediate containment plan: revoke the key, rotate any secrets using it, and search access logs for suspicious usage. @josh-devops can you revoke and rotate in 10m?
josh-devops: on it. will run revocation + create replacement via KMS-wrapped secret in secrets-manager. posting commands I run: 
```
# list suspected keys
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name ci-bot-user
# disable and then delete the key
aws iam update-access-key --user-name ci-bot-user --access-key-id AKIAREDACTED --status Inactive
aws iam delete-access-key --user-name ci-bot-user --access-key-id AKIAREDACTED
# create new keys via service account rotation
aws iam create-access-key --user-name ci-bot-user
# store in Secrets Manager encrypted with KMS
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id /redwood/ci/ci-bot-user --secret-string "{...}" --region us-west-2
```
sre-bot: observed immediate revocation event at 1790123520 by josh-devops (IAM) — access key status changed to Inactive.
kevin-eng: repo grep shows the key string was accidentally echoed in a pipeline step when a debugging env var was printed. only in one recent build (1342).
kevin-eng: I pushed a tiny pipeline change to remove the debug echo and added `mask: true` to the step. PR: https://git.redwood/example/pipelines/987
ami na-cs: (amina-cs) checking whether any customer data was touched: what logs should I look at?
maria-sec: run these checks:
1) CloudTrail `ConsoleLogin`, `AssumeRole`, `Invoke` events in the 6h window around the build.
2) S3 GET/PUT events for buckets tagged with customer-data.
3) Any API calls to the Redwood production endpoints authenticated with that key (should be none; CI user scoped to infra).
Use this query snippet for CloudTrail logs in Athena: 
```
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventTime BETWEEN timestamp '2026-03-12 04:00:00' AND timestamp '2026-03-12 10:00:00'
AND (userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName = 'ci-bot-user' OR userIdentity.arn LIKE '%ci-bot-user%')
```
amina-cs: running S3 and CloudTrail queries now, will post results in 30m.
rotations-bot: rotation workflow triggered by josh-devops for secret `/redwood/ci/ci-bot-user` — status: in-progress. rotation id: rot-20260312-01
josh-devops: new access key created and KMS-wrapped secret stored at `/redwood/ci/ci-bot-user:v2` — replacing references in all active pipeline jobs. rolling update started.
maria-sec: good. next: audit all service tokens for reuse across environments, and check whether build artifact uploads or deploys happened while key was live. prioritize production buckets.
kevin-eng: checked artifacts registry: the pipeline only pushed to internal staging registry. no production deploy triggered by that build.
amina-cs: CloudTrail scan summary (6h window): 0 S3:GetObject on customer buckets, 1 AssumeRole by ci-bot-user into deploy-staging-role at 2026-03-12T05:12:10Z, no unusual source IPs (matching our build agents).
maria-sec: that lowers customer-impact risk. still: we need formal incident record, timeline, and communications checklist. @oliver-legal we might need to prepare a disclosure if we see downstream access, but for now looks low impact.
oliver-legal: please capture the timeline, actions, and affected principals. will review disclosure thresholds. also keep retention of logs untouched.
maria-sec: creating incident record now in tracker: INC-2026-0312-01. assigning owners and action items.
maria-sec: action items (short):
- josh-devops: confirm all pipeline references rotated + delete old keys (ETA 30m)
- kevin-eng: PR to remove masking gap + add scanner rule to catch `AKIA` patterns in logs (ETA 2h)
- amina-cs: final CloudTrail & S3 confirmation + statement for ops (ETA 1h)
- oliver-legal: advise on disclosure + prepare notice template if needed (ETA 2h)
- maria-sec: write postmortem draft + add mitigation plan for preventing pipeline secrets from appearing in logs (ETA EOD)

josh-devops: confirmed: old key deleted at 1790123600, all active pipeline references updated. rotation workflow completed.
kevin-eng: added masking by default to pipeline debug steps and updated internal CI linter rule to fail on `echo $AWS` style prints. test CI rule in staging.
amina-cs: final check results: no customer buckets accessed, no production deploys. all checks clean.
maria-sec: nice work. we'll keep the incident open for postmortem and to roll out the CI linter wide. please add any missed notes to INC-2026-0312-01.
oliver-legal: thanks — if anything changes, loop me in. no external disclosure needed at this time per my assessment.
rotations-bot: rotation workflow closed: rot-20260312-01 status: success.
maria-sec: follow-ups: enforce KMS-wrapped secrets for all CI users, add redwood-ci role with no long-lived IAM keys (use ephemeral credentials), and tighten logging retention for forensic needs. scheduling follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. :white_check_mark:
kevin-eng: will draft the linter rule PR and send to devex for rollout.
ci-bot: closing note: flagged build 1342 for removal from public logs and scrubbed artifact list.
maria-sec: incident state -> contained. moving to postmortem stage. thanks everyone for fast response. :rocket:
